Chronology of every recorded fact about [[sword aura]], in reading order. Generated from the same verified fact store as the main article.

== Soulsmith ==
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-02-soulsmith|'''Ch 1''' — Sword aura can be drawn in and cycled to become part of a practitioner's spirit or madra.}}
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-02-soulsmith|'''Ch 3''' — Sword aura gathers around anything with an edge.}}
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-02-soulsmith|'''Ch 13''' — Yerin's pale blade gathers sword aura.}}

== Blackflame ==
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-03-blackflame|'''Ch 13''' — Vital aura generates sword aura.}}
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-03-blackflame|'''Ch 17''' — Yerin's Goldsign produces sword aura.}}
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-03-blackflame|'''Ch 19''' — Sword aura can be turned from vital aura.}}
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-03-blackflame|'''Ch 19''' — Sword aura cannot be used for defense on the Path of the Endless Sword.}}

* {{spoiler|book=cradle-04-skysworn|'''Ch 1''' — Sword aura is a specific adaptation of force aura.}}

* {{spoiler|book=cradle-06-underlord|'''Ch 21''' — Yerin was under the pressure of a sword aura.}}
